question: Why Does Foam Affect Level Sensors?
body_html:
Foam affects level sensors because the sensor may detect the foam layer instead of the true liquid surface, causing wrong readings, fluctuations or false alarms.

SensorFoam effect
UltrasonicFoam absorbs sound, signal lost
Non-contact radarBetter, but heavy foam weakens echoes
Guided wave radarProbe guided signal, most reliable
Conductive switchWet foam causes false switching
FloatFoam deposits can restrict movement
